pillars.title: Engineered for cognitive bandwidth, not infinite scrolling.
pillars.description: Traditional flashcard apps confuse chaotic activity with durable memory. VocabFlash structures your lexical inputs into disciplined, distraction-free acquisition loops.

session.label: PILLAR 01
session.title: Session-Based Focus
session.description: Group vocabulary by authentic academic domains, IELTS band criteria, or your bespoke reading list. Import effortlessly from XLSX or CSV spreadsheets with zero reformatting.

quiz.title: Instant 4-Option Quizzes
quiz.descriptionPrefix: Dynamically generate multiple-choice challenges across three directional modes:
quiz.descriptionSuffix: and synonym discernment with instant recall scoring.

learningCurve.label: PILLAR 03
learningCurve.title: Immutable Learning Curves
learningCurve.description: Observe dense daily retention data mapped against modified Ebbinghaus curves. Identify persistent blind spots without opaque algorithms holding your word list hostage.

howItWorks.title: How serious learners study with VocabFlash.
howItWorks.description: A seamless flow designed to minimize friction between discovering a new academic word and locking it into long-term recall.

capture.label: STEP 01
capture.title: Capture & Import
capture.description: Drag and drop your spreadsheet or input words directly. VocabFlash automatically supplements missing IPA phonetics, parts of speech, and nuance synonyms via lexical intelligence.
capture.columnMapping: Column mapping: [Word, Part of Speech, Context, Meaning]

review.label: STEP 02
review.title: Spaced Card Review
review.description: Enter distraction-free study mode. Utilize keyboard shortcuts to flip, pronounce, and rate difficulty. Leitner intervals automatically space upcoming reviews to peak retention curves.

verify.label: STEP 03
verify.title: Challenge & Verify
verify.description: End each review block with a calibrated quiz session. Snapshot your historical velocity and witness active vocabulary transition into permanent natural intuition.

arena.title: Zero friction, 4-option verification.
arena.description: Test yourself with precision. Answers are verified in milliseconds, providing the phonetic transcription alongside contextual feedback so you learn the nuance, not just the translation.

directional.title: Directional testing:
directional.body: Toggle between English-to-Vietnamese, Vietnamese-to-English, or nuance synonym matching.

keyboard.title: Keyboard-first speed:
keyboard.body: Press keys 1, 2, 3, or 4 for instantaneous, fluid testing workflows.

recycling.title: Mistake-driven recycling:
recycling.body: Incorrect selections are queued back into the active review box.
